why_ai: Audiences follow a specific person, but AI-generated content competes hard for the same attention.
why_clarity: Views and retention arrive within hours, but what makes content good is craft and taste.
why_digital: Some filming happens in real places; editing, publishing, audience and brand deals are online.

why_ai: Consolidating payouts, contractor payments and forecasts is bookkeeping software absorbs directly.
why_clarity: Revenue, costs and margin per video reconcile to exact figures every month.
why_digital: Payout statements, invoices and contractor payments are handled entirely online.

why_ai: Reading thousands of comments as research is text analysis that language models already do well.
why_clarity: Huge recurring comment corpus, but what the audience wants is an interpretive judgment.
why_digital: Input is a text corpus; output is digital insight for the creator.

why_ai: Prediction and diagnosis from the channel's own record is analytics software, despite the platform confound.
why_clarity: Views are measurable, but creator choices and algorithm distribution are confounded in the result.
why_digital: Built from platform analytics and catalogue data, delivered as software.

why_ai: Segmenting, reframing and captioning one video into six formats is what AI clipping tools already do.
why_clarity: Platform format specs are fixed and every upload repeats; clip quality retains a taste element.
why_digital: Video in, platform-ready video files out, all edited on screen.

why_ai: Conversion, segmentation and product-fit decisions are software tasks with some product judgment.
why_clarity: List growth and conversion are measurable, though which product fits an audience is a judgment.
why_digital: Email lists, memberships and storefronts are online; some products ship as physical merch.

why_ai: Causal inference under a recommendation confound is hard analysis, but entirely software work.
why_clarity: No ground truth separates creator choices from algorithm distribution, so explanations cannot be checked.
why_digital: Inputs are platform analytics; output is a digital explanation.

why_ai: Ranking candidate titles and thumbnails against a rich catalogue is a model, not a person.
why_clarity: Every upload repeats the choice, and click-through confirms or refutes the ranking within days.
why_digital: Candidate titles, thumbnails and catalogue data in, ranked options out, all digital.

why_ai: Pipeline and delivery tracking automate; brand relationships and rate negotiation keep managers involved.
why_clarity: Contracted deliverables are checkable, but rate-setting is a guess and brand results are self-reported.
why_digital: Deals run by email and tracking tools, with some brand relationships built in person.

why_ai: The person is the product audiences follow, though AI output competes and assists their workload.
why_clarity: Public metrics arrive fast, but sustainable output and good content are personal and taste-driven.
why_digital: Filming can be physical, but production, publishing and audience are online.

why_ai: Pacing and cut calls are taste, but AI editing tools are absorbing rough cuts and routine edits.
why_clarity: Hundreds of judgment calls per video against vague timestamp feedback; quality is taste.
why_digital: Footage in, edited files out, often from contractors working remotely abroad.
